England faces Mexico in World Cup amid fan celebrations and tactical concerns

Ahead of a World Cup match between England and Mexico, reports indicate heightened security measures in Mexico City following deadly celebrations. The England team's arrival was met with boos, and tactical discussions are underway regarding the high-altitude environment. Meanwhile, masked wrestlers have also captured attention at the event.
